title: MV Sound Effect Playing When a Critical Attack Lands Plugin, Does it Exist ?

posts.author: KastoMaria77
posts.body: i noticed in vx ace there's a script that makes it so whenever a crit lands a sound effect plays does this exist on MV ?

posts.body:

i noticed in vx ace there's a script that makes it so whenever a crit lands a sound effect plays does this exist on MV ?

You might find some success with Victor Engine's Critical Hit Effects by running a script call to play a different sound effect. I am sure there are other plugins that can do something similar.
VE - Critical Hit Effects

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The above comes to mind; you could also use Yanfly's Damage Core. Or Yanfly's Auto Passive States with Buffs & States Core. Or Action Sequences.
All are more complicated solutions than Victor's, but there are tons of options.
